The Parallel World of Darkness!'') is the 26th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Wicke]] and an {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}} learn [[Lusamine]] is on [[Poni Island]] with a group of [[Ultra Beast]]s. * Unable to get past the Ultra Beasts guarding the island, Wicke and the Employee return to the [[Aether House]], where they tell [[Gladion]] and [[Lillie]] what they learned. * The Employee reveals [[Faba]] managed to take control of the [[Aether Foundation]]. * [[Anabel]] is revealed to have gone into the [[Ultra Wormhole]] at the [[Poni Altar]]. * The [[Trial Captain]]s and [[island kahuna]]s are revealed to have started training to face the Ultra Beasts. * Wicke and the Employee decide to head back to Aether Foundation to get more information before making the next move. * {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}} are revealed to have ended up at the [[Ultra Deep Sea]] and have been separated from [[Nebby|Lunala]]. * The {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Zygarde Cells}} Sun collected are revealed to be able to fuse into its 10% Forme. * Moon's {{TP|Moon|Rowlet}} is revealed to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Dartrix}}. * Sun and Moon change into a new pair of clothes. * Sun and Moon encounter Lunala again, but it is being ridden by [[Dulse]] and [[Zossie]], who Sun mistakes for enemies. {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Dulse]] * [[Zossie]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Dartrix}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== *
